plan.notes: Official CSUDH 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, English B.A. program page, English Literature Concentration 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid). Semester sums reconcile exactly with printed Hours; total 120. GENUINE CATALOG FORMATTING ANOMALIES DOCUMENTED (not silently corrected): (1) Second Year Fall prints a stray 'GE Area 5A Physical Sciences OR 5B Biological Sciences' line with no hour value between the 'Elective to meet 120' row and the ENG 205 row — including it would push the semester to 18 vs the printed 15, and ENG 205 (a required lower-division core course) appears nowhere else in the roadmap, so the five rows with explicit hours (GE 1B, Elective Course, GE Area 4A, Elective to meet 120, ENG 205 = 15) are sequenced; (2) Second Year Spring prints a stray 'GE Area 5C Laboratory' line with no hour value — the five rows with explicit hours sum to the printed 15. 'HIS 101 or POL 101', 'ENG 202/203/204', 'ENG 240/241', 'ENG 342/345/346', 'ENG 325/326/327', 'ENG 465/476' modeled as choice slots with code = first-listed option per convention. The two 'Major Elective' slots are the catalog's 'two additional upper division courses in English' (D. requirement); ENG 305 and ENG 350 may not count. ENG 490 satisfies GWAR per source. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented; sequencing follows the official roadmap order.
